caption: The drawing depicts a long, flowing garment, primarily colored in red with decorative patterns and details. The garment is adorned with an ornamental border in a golden-brown shade along the edges and across the upper section. Floral and bird motifs, in colors such as blue, pink, green, and white, are scattered across the surface of the fabric. A yolk-shaped panel is present at the upper center back, with emboldened gold-brown borders and multicolored vertical stripes (blue, yellow, green, white, and red) at the bottom of this panel. The garment appears to have pleats or folds, adding to its voluminous appearance, and the overall composition is centered on a plain, cream-colored background. The artist's signature, "Syrena Swanson," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Ecclesiastical Vestment (back view)
